title: OpenTelemetry announcements configuration
description: How merged announcements are delivered, and to which destinations.

mode.description: Mode for merged announcements: check (preview only), draft (drafts in Buffer and Groups.io, Slack previewed only) or publish.

targets.description: Destinations per channel, by name. Announcements can skip a channel or a single destination by its name.

slack.description: Slack channel IDs (not names), for example C0123456789.

buffer.description: Buffer channel IDs (not organization IDs), one per service.
